en: Angel's hero, huh... Seeing people like{n}you... makes my skin crawl...

jp: どうして、あなたは戦うの？{n}こんな無意味なこと、やめてください！
en: Why do you fight? Please, stop this{n}senseless thing!

jp: フン、お嬢さんには関係ねえよ。
en: Hmph, that's none of your{n}business, little lady.

en: This world's nothing special. I'd feel{n}better if it was just gone.
